description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). Move through a recipe the way the cook does on the phone, on the same shared state: whichever of you moves the step, the other sees it after the phone's next sync. `start` begins a run at step 1 (or continues the one in progress; with `step`, at that step), `next`/`back` move one step (`next` on the last step finishes), `goto` jumps to `step`, `timer` starts the timer of the current step (or of `step`) on the board with an absolute finish time, and `finish` ends the run (timers already running keep running).

action.description: What to do; see the tool description.

notify.description: Only for `timer`: notify the cook's phone that the timer is on.

recipe.description: Id or name of the recipe (read_recipes).

step.description: A step number, counting from 1. Required for `goto`; optional for `start` and `timer`.

name: cook_recipe

cook.description: Where the run is now (step, of, title), or null when no run is in progress.

delivery.description: How recently the phone checked in, so you never imply it has seen this.

lastSyncAgo.description: Last sync in words, e.g. '2m ago'.

notified.description: A push about this change went out.

phoneAlert.description: Whether the paired device's backup alarm armed, and which device that is. armed:false is a real answer, not an error.

alarmsArmed.description: Finish alarms armed by this call.

armed.description: true only if a server alarm is set AND this phone can receive push.

device.description: Which device will ring: the phone app (Android or installed app), a browser tab (rings only while the tab stays open), no paired device, or one that has not said (older version).

pushedToPhone.description: A notification about this change was sent.

reason.description: Why nothing armed, in words worth repeating to the cook.

startRemindersArmed.description: Start reminders armed for scheduled dishes.

summary.description: One sentence naming the device that will ring, worth repeating to the cook as is.

willAlertWhileAsleep.description: true only when armed AND the device is the phone app. A browser tab or an unknown device is never promised.

recipe.description: The recipe: id, name, step and timer counts, whether a run is in progress.

step.description: The current step in full (title, text, timer).

timer.description: For `timer`: the step's timer on the board.

warnings.description: Things worth saying out loud that are not failures.

title: Cook a recipe step by step
